title: Savory Kielbasa and Paleo Paleo Skillet
description: A hearty skillet dish featuring kielbasa and paleo-friendly vegetables, all cooked to perfection in one pan.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the kielbasa and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the paleo paleo, red bell pepper, and yellow onion to the skillet.
Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, salt, and black pepper to the skillet.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
